captureNotes: Real TaskWindow captures on a separate local database, fictional example data. Includes calendar timezone fix from this branch. Dark capture activates the existing dark media rule via CSSOM; no UI content is replaced. Desktop capture is a 1440×960 emulated touch viewport.
